_doc: Revert-verify for ems__Bug 413f80b9 (ExoSync: exo__Asset_updatedAt changed on both sides keeps the later stamp), subject = StructuredMerger.ts. Axes U*/T* in packages/core/tests/unit/services/sync/StructuredMerger.updatedat.test.ts. The DEFAULT naive mapping (DEVICE_LOCAL_TIME) has no mutant: in a UTC runner device-local time IS UTC, so a mutant swapping it for UTC is indistinguishable by construction; U11 runs the default with naive-vs-naive stamps, whose order holds in any zone. Run: python3 -I ~/.claude/bin/mutant-driver.py <this spec> after setting `tree` and `subject` to YOUR checkout.
subject: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO YOUR exocortex CHECKOUT>/packages/core/src/services/sync/StructuredMerger.ts

M1_rule_never_applies._note: The pre-fix behaviour: the stamp is an ordinary scalar. U6 reddens too, and that is expected: its asset lists the stamp BEFORE ems__Effort_startTimestamp, so without the rule the merge stops at the stamp and the conflict reason names exo__Asset_updatedAt instead of the key U6 asserts.

M3_compared_as_text._note: Lexical order disagrees with time order in U3/U5/U10 (offset/Z/naive mixes); in U4 they happen to agree.

M5_unparseable_treated_as_zero._note: An unparseable stamp read as epoch 0 silently loses to any real stamp instead of conflicting.

M6_offset_sign_ignored._note: Only T1 carries a negative offset.

M9_other_key_conflict_hidden._note: Drops the key-name check: a both-sides change of ANOTHER timestamp-valued key (U6) would be resolved by max instead of conflicting.
